title: Allay & Vex Conversion
description: Allows the conversion of allays to vexes and vice versa
body:
It is very simple (kind of?)


<details>
<summary>Allay -> Vex</summary>

1. Give the allay any item
2. _Shift + Right-Click_ with an **Ominous Bottle** on the Allay to give it **Bad Omen**
3. Wait the duration of the effect (4min)
4. When the effect runs out the allay will become a vex

</details>


<details>
<summary>Vex -> Allay</summary>

1. Throw a **splash potion of regeneration and weakness** on the vex (if you are fast enough)
2. Feed the vex **Amethyst Shards**
3. Everytime you feed the vex 3 things could happen: It converts, it dies, or it chokes
   
- 1. If it chokes it takes 1hp of damage (half a heart)
- 2. If it dies, well it dies...
- 3. If it converts it will become an allay
</details>


<details>
<summary>Bonus</summary>

- Allays leave a particle trail that can be stopped by making it hold an **Echo Shard** or giving it **Bad Omen**
- _Shift + Right-Click_ with a **Milk Bucket** on the Allay to remove its effects
- 2 new gamerules ("allowAllayVexConversion" and "allayParticleEffects") both by default true
- Vexes that come from conversion are weaponless (still hostile)

</details>
